macros.name: cleanseqsc
macros.doc: The command \cleanseqsc removes all 〈stored content 〉 in the sequence {〈seq name 〉}.

macros.name: countsc
macros.doc: User command \countsc to count number of 〈stored contents 〉 in the sequence.

macros.name: foreachsc
macros.doc: User command \foreachsc to loop over 〈stored content 〉 in sequence.

macros.name: getstored
macros.doc: The \getstored command retrieves the 〈stored content 〉 according to the integer value set in 〈index 〉 which corresponds to the position of the 〈stored content 〉 in the sequence {〈seq name 〉}.

macros.name: meaningsc
macros.doc: The command \meaningsc executes \meaning on the 〈stored content 〉 in the sequence {〈seq name 〉}.

macros.name: mergesc
macros.doc: The command \mergesc assembles the 〈stored content 〉 in the sequences {〈seq A〉}[1], {〈seq B〉}[2-5] and {〈seq C 〉}[1-end] and then executes \typestored (§5.6) if the typestored key is active or \meaningsc (§5.7) if the meaningsc key is active.

macros.name: newenvsc
macros.doc: The command \newenvsc allows you to create 〈new environments 〉 based on the same characteristics of the scontents environment.

macros.name: Scontents
macros.doc: The \Scontents command reads the {〈argument 〉} in standard mode and “stores” it in the sequence set by the key store-cmd at the time it is executed.

macros.name: setupsc
macros.doc: The command \setupsc sets the 〈keys 〉 in a global way, it can be used both in the preamble and in the body of the document as many times as desired.

macros.name: typestored
macros.doc: The command \typestored places the 〈stored content 〉 in the sequence {〈seq name 〉} into the internally verbatimsc environment (§5.9).

envs.name: verbatimsc
envs.doc: The verbatimsc environment is, in a way, a customized version of the standard verbatim environment provided by LaTeX.
